_comment: Animation set for the humanoid actor in the unarmed weapon state. Gameplay requests an AnimIntent; this file resolves which clip plays. Equipment-state branching (armed vs unarmed) lives in WHICH set is active on the actor, not in gameplay code -- see [[anim-intent-animset-architecture]] in agent memory. To add a new intent: add it to AnimIntent enum + map it here. The AnimSet loader asserts every intent is mapped, so missing entries fail loud at load time.
_placeholders: Some intents alias to imperfect clips because the unarmed library lacks a dedicated source. Acceptable for now; re-download a proper clip from Mixamo when polish requires it. Today's known aliases: LocoCrouch=running_crawl (prone, not crouch), ActionGetUp=getting_up (correct), ActionBlock*=center_block (held stance used as raise/hold/lower), ActionImpact=sword_and_shield_impact (no unarmed flinch yet), Action(Dying|Death)=sword_and_shield_death (sword-holding death used for unarmed), ActionAttackCasting/PowerUp=combo (unarmed isn't typically magic-using).
